files.humanResources:
Purrchena, Brand Ambassador for the Talos-II General Chamber of Commerce's (TGCC) Ætherside Environmental Impact Syndrome Relief Foundation, currently stationed at Endfield Industries as the liaison between Endfield and TGCC in the field of Ætherside Syndrome relief.

The first time I met Purrchena, her sunny, cheerful demeanor and the way her personality matched her on-screen persona exactly left a deep impression on me. During our conversations, she always had the other operators in the room bursting with laughter.
Another thing that left a strong impression on me was her Ætherside Syndrome. Although the relief foundation had already informed us of her condition in advance, when she suddenly fell asleep right in the middle of our conversation, I still felt a sense of admiration. Even while suffering from her own illness, she still chose to help other patients. That spirit of altruism is truly precious.
— Martin Marvin Malen, Assistant, HR Division, Endfield Industries
files.file1:
Dear Supervisor Perlica of Endfield Industries, the Business Office, and the Human Resources Division:
I hope this finds you well.
To further promote communication and cooperation between our two parties in the field of Ætherside Environmental Impact Syndrome relief, I am writing to recommend Ms. Rosalind for a position in the Business Office under Endfield Industries.
First, I must explain Ms. Rosalind's condition to you. She suffers from an incurable form of Ætherside Syndrome. The syndrome attacks and damages her central nervous system, causing her to frequently and suddenly fall asleep. Please rest assured, however, that over the past six years, the upgrades we have made to her personal protective device, along with the long-term medical care we have provided, ensure that her daily work remains unaffected.
I am sure your organization has heard of the rescue operation Ms. Rosalind participated in five years ago. According to the post-operation summary report, when a storm suddenly doubled back, the search and rescue team and the Ætherside Syndrome patients had no choice but to take shelter in a cave. Since the original plan had been to relocate the patients, the operation's medical supplies were extremely limited. Fortunately, Ms. Rosalind, having traveled extensively with her parents and treated Ætherside Syndrome patients even in the absence of medication, had considerable experience in such situations. With her help, the patients' conditions did not worsen further. According to other team members' debriefings, when the storm was directly above the cave, an RV van that had been blocking the entrance slid out. She immediately grabbed a wooden plank and sealed the gap. After the storm passed, following coverage by our media, the name Purrchena began to circulate throughout the Civilization Band. I must admit, the relief foundation's strategy of having a representative of the patients themselves drive the relief work has indeed proven effective. It has provided us with a large number of valuable special cases while also significantly increasing demand for pharmaceuticals and medical equipment from multiple drug companies.
When I recall the first time I met her, her long bouts of irregular sleep had left her eyes vacant and her face gaunt. Had it not been for Ms. Rosalind's adoptive father reaching out to me, given her condition at the time, even if her Ætherside Syndrome did not worsen, her body would hardly have sustained her into adulthood. Out of humanitarian principles, and also as an investment in the future, we provided her with comprehensive medical care and educational support. As a result, we have a thorough understanding of her professional capabilities. I believe that through this bridge built by Ms. Rosalind, both our parties will achieve strong synergy in the relief of Ætherside Syndrome patients.
Should your organization wish to further advance cooperation in the field of Ætherside Environmental Impact Syndrome relief, we stand ready to provide support for communication between our two parties at any time. Thank you for taking the time to read this letter. We look forward to achieving more substantive collaboration in the future.
Sincerely
— H, Representative of the Highburg Pharmaceuticals LLC Ætherside Syndrome Business Unit, President of the Ætherside Environmental Impact Syndrome Relief Foundation
files.file2:
"You're watching Frontline Face-to-Face. Our reporter has arrived at the Ætherside Syndrome medical center in northern La Fantoma and has gotten in touch with the Brand Ambassador of the Ætherside Environmental Impact Syndrome Relief Foundation. Let us now go live to the scene. Ms. Purrchena, this is Dinah. Can you hear me over there?"
"Yes, hello Dinah! Hello everyone! I am Purrchena, the Brand Ambassador for the Ætherside Environmental Impact Syndrome Relief Foundation."
"Hello, Ms. Purrchena. We are all very concerned about this emergency lockdown. Could you tell us what the situation is like over there? I heard you happened to be there visiting Ætherside Syndrome patients when it happened."
"Huh? I mean, yeeeaahhh I could ... but are you sure you want me to talk about it now? I remember a lot of kids watch your show."
"Haha, don't worry! We're professionals here. If what you say gets a bit too intense, we will give you a heads up."
"Okay, cuz the patients living here are all in very serious condition. The one I remember most vividly had his back covered in wounds that looked like they had been slashed by a knife. I saw a doctor touch one of them with a piece of Originium, and the wound just twisted and contorted."
"That is quite peculiar ... and rather frightening. Could you elaborate on Ætherside Environmental Impact Syndrome? We really do not know much about it at the moment."
"Um... Well, it is more or less what the textbooks say. If we go into any more detail, even we would have to read through several very thick books just to barely understand it. But to put it in the words of one of the relief foundation's researchers, it is less a disease in the traditional sense and more a unique phenomenon that manifests when Ætherside environments affect the human body."
"I see. Then is this sudden lockdown really because of an Ætherside Syndrome patient, just like the official announcement says?"
"Correct."
"So what exactly happened? There are rumors that something similar to the disintegration phenomenon seen in Oripathy positive patients occurred."
"Not at all! Disintegration happens after a patient dies, but Ætherside Syndrome doesn't. I was talking to him just a moment ago, and then in an instant he was... Thank goodness I was the only one in the isolation ward at the time. Sigh, even though the medical center's condition monitoring system is very thorough, it is completely helpless against this kind of situation."
"Ahh... So it sounds like the progression of Ætherside Syndrome is very difficult to predict?"
"That is the hardest part about treating these patients. And the unpredictability varies from case to case. Sometimes the condition suddenly worsens. Sometimes the symptoms abruptly change."
"The symptoms can change?"
"Yeah. Take me for example. Right now Purrchena's symptom is falling asleep at any moment. But if Purrchena were to enter a high-depth environment without the proper protective gear, she might end up flickering like a person on a broken handyterm screen. Or there might be another Purrchena, visible but intangible, waving and greeting everyone, while the real Purrchena lies as if asleep and cannot be roused no matter how much you call. Of course, this risk applies not just to patients, but to any ordinary person who enters a high-depth environment as well."
"It truly is an unpredictable illness. Therefore, everyone must make sure to wear their protective gear properly before entering any high-depth environment!"
"Absolutely right! If for any reason you must enter a high-depth environment, be sure to wear your protective gear correctly. And of course, for high-depth environments, avoid unless absolutely necessary!"
"Thank you for that reminder, Ms. Purrchena. To wrap up the interview, is there anything else you would like to say to our audience?"
"Oooooh yes I do. Although we still cannot cure Ætherside Syndrome, please do not panic. As long as you do not come into contact with high-depth environments, there is no risk of contracting it. And please do not treat the patients around you like monsters. Ætherside Syndrome is not ... is not ... contagious..."
"Ms. Purrchena? Uh... Ms. Purrchena?"
"...*BEEP*"
"Uh... Looks like we're experiencing some technical difficulties. Next up, let us speak to..."
files.file3:
...... 
La Fantoma. I do not think I need to repeat how well the Siesta Group manages this free city, nor do I need to elaborate on how much vitality the Talos-II General Chamber of Commerce has breathed into it. But before I talk about the free city of La Fantoma, I would like to first mention a friend I met on this journey, one who gave me tremendous help in writing this chapter on La Fantoma. 
Just as I did upon arriving in any other city, I wandered into a mall to figure out where to go next, just like any other commercial hub in La Fantoma. The building was packed with businesses from all across the band, and in the middle of it all was an open-air market bustling with customers and roaming vendors. I picked a drink stand with a good view and had barely sat down when I spotted a "white Feline mascot", impossible to miss. At first I thought it was some shop's costumed character, but on closer look, she was not trying to draw in customers. She just stood there staring at a dessert shop's window display, while passersby greeted her warmly, as if everyone in the city knew her. 
To get a feel for the city's culture, I walked up and said hello. Only after she repeatedly confirmed that I was not some tabloid reporter trying to dig up secrets like whether the Ætherside Environmental Impact Syndrome Relief Foundation had signed any backroom deals with pharmaceutical companies, did she tell me who she was. Please forgive me for not being familiar with the various representatives and codenames of TGCC's enterprises, foundations, and administrative departments. It was only after we parted ways that I learned exactly which characters made up the name Purrchena. When she learned that I was there to document everyday life in La Fantoma and write a travel guide, she bounced cheerfully and led me out of the mall, taking on the role of my guide. The food recommendations later in this chapter were all compiled under the guidance of Ms. Purrchena. Perhaps it was her vivid and animated explanations, especially when she would suddenly fall asleep mid-sentence and then wake up, scratching her head and apologizing before continuing, that even made places like TGCC headquarters feel interesting. 
...... 
When I asked her how she viewed La Fantoma and the other free cities, she just smiled and said she would take me to a fun place, then led me away from the bustling streets and out to the beach. The crowd soon separated us, but before long, I found her again by following the people slowly forming a circle around her. She was sitting on the sand, bobbing her head to the beat of the music, occasionally changing the expressions on her electronic face screen to startle the children climbing over her and playing along. Though I was still some distance away, their laughter still reached my ears through the music. The others around either pulled out their cameras to take photos or joined in the children's revelry, dancing to the melody. She was surrounded by joy and laughter. After the crowd dispersed and the children reluctantly said goodbye to her under their parents' watch, I was finally able to approach her. I noticed she had fallen asleep again, but was still gently swaying her head. I sat down beside her and listened to her soft breathing. She must have been having a beautiful dream. 
— A preface to the La Fantoma chapter of Talos-II Beneath Our Feet, accompanied by a photograph of Purrchena playing with children.
files.file4:
November 2, Year 145, clear skies. Today mom drove the RV to a place where lots of other RVs were parked. The uncles and aunties there helped mom upgrade our RV, and now it has become so big and comfortable that even sleeping right on the floor feels great. No more worrying about getting hurt if I suddenly collapse. The uncles and aunties also gave me a really, really tasty snack. I think it was called exotic dried fin. Heh, when I grow up, I am going to buy so much exotic dried fin that I can stuff our RV full with it. 
...... 
May 7, Year 146, snow turning to clear skies. Mom and some uncles and aunties drove a caravan of RVs to a city up in the snowy mountains. Good thing the RV was nice and warm. Mom and I did not feel cold at all. Heh, let dad go out and treasure hunt by himself. This time dad found a machine bone. He said that once he fixed it up, I would be able to go out and play with the other kids! 
...... 
June 23, Year 146, overcast turning to rain. The machine bone did not seem to like the rain. It just stood there in the rain and stopped moving. Luckily the other kids who came along all had umbrellas and stayed with me in the rain to wait for mom and dad. But I don't really remember what happened after that. I think I had a dream. I dreamed I was riding a flying burdenbeast and went to so many places. When I woke up, mom was holding me and crying for some reason. Dad seemed to be blaming the machine bone. I tried to comfort mom, but she only cried harder. I hate falling asleep... 
...... 
July 16, Year 146, clear skies. We came back to this place where they make movies. There are so many beautiful clothes here. This is my favorite place. I had just helped the uncles and aunties carry the boxes off the RV when dad came back with a very neatly dressed uncle. The uncle was not as nimble as I was. Even though our RV was big enough to fit all of Talos-II inside, he still had to carefully pick his way around inside it. Mom was also very happy today. She brought out a lot of the good food that we usually only save for our birthdays. 
...... 
August 20, Year 146, overcast. This RV was not like mom's. It was very clean inside, with lots of metal boxes, cramped and cold. There were also a lot of uncles and aunties in white coats. They all smiled at me, but I did not feel happy at all. The uncle dad knew gave me a strange little box. I could hear mom and dad's voices from it, but when I took the box apart, they were nowhere to be found... 
...... 
December 18, Year 146, clear skies. Today was my first time joining a rescue mission. All my teammates were familiar faces. The RV was cramped, but everyone was chatting and laughing. I really liked the atmosphere! But a few of the relief foundation's directors thought it was too dangerous for me to go to a place like that and said I would not be allowed to join rescue operations of that level again. I'm so pissed! The mission went perfectly, and it was not my fault the storm suddenly turned back. Still, after the operation was over, I got to see mom and dad. I even helped mom take the patients to the nearest city for treatment. Hey, when was the last time I saw them anyway? 
...... 
November 7, Year 151, clear skies. We will reach our destination tomorrow. Time flies. It feels like just yesterday that I received the reply letter from Endfield Industries. What does the Endministrator actually look like? Is it really the same as what the textbooks say? Sighhhhh, boring! This RV is completely empty, nothing in it at all. Oh, and today I ran into mom and dad. They were transporting supplies from La Fantoma to Valley IV. We took a photo together, so they can see me in the picture and not miss me too much. But even though mom's RV is decorated exactly the same as when I was little, why does it feel like something has changed?

Charity: Best Ambassador
"Ambassador? Oh, you're talking about Purrchena. She was super helpful to us. Look. We prepared all these snacks for her, as a token of our gratitude!"

voiceLines.title: Operation Prep 1
voiceLines.text: My turn to ... "Meow-dy!" ...Ugh, how am I asleep again?!

voiceLines.title: Operation Prep 2
voiceLines.text: Nnn... Gah! Is it mission time?

voiceLines.title: Adding to Team 1
voiceLines.text: Who's sleepy? Not me!

voiceLines.title: Adding to Team 2
voiceLines.text: Got my marshmallows and exotic dried fin... Alright, I'm good to go!

voiceLines.title: Switching Weapon
voiceLines.text: Oh, nice grip! If I use this as a snack skewer, I can keep my fluffy suit totally mess-free!

voiceLines.title: Switching Gear
voiceLines.text: Whoa, it actually fits my suit... "Exotic dried fin! YUM-YUM!" ...Wait, what's going on? I'm not asleep yet!

voiceLines.title: Talent Node Activation
voiceLines.text: Mmm... GASP! I've got it! The solution to the pathology experiment is— Wait, what? Where'd that idea go?!

voiceLines.title: Watching Combat Records
voiceLines.text: The TGCC never taught me anything like this. Wow... I didn't know you could do that!

voiceLines.title: Operator Promotion 1
voiceLines.text: Ooh, a promotion! Back at the Relief Foundation, these celebrations meant one thing: piles of pastries... What? We don't do celebration cakes here?

voiceLines.title: Operator Promotion 2
voiceLines.text: For real? Yes! I can't wait to tell mom and dad and everyone back home. They're gonna ... they'll be ... so happy for me... "See ya!"

voiceLines.title: Operator Promotion 3
voiceLines.text: Promoted again?! If I'm dreaming, don't wake me up! I'll make sure everyone stays safe and sound. Leave it to me!

voiceLines.title: Operator Promotion 4
voiceLines.text: Sometimes, I think about what life would be like if I'd never left for La Fantoma with the Relief Foundation... Hmph. No matter where I ended up, I'd still be me, always lending a hand!

voiceLines.title: Operator Reporting for Duty
voiceLines.text: Greetings, Endmin! I am the Brand Ambassador for the Ætherside Environmental Impact Syndrome Relief Foundation — Purrchena! My dream is to be ... someone just like y... "Brand Ambassador for the Ætherside Environmental Impact Syndrome Relief Foundation — Purrchena!"... *gasp* no, no, no, I dozed off again!

voiceLines.title: Standing by 1
voiceLines.text: Hi, Endmin! I'm wide awake!

voiceLines.title: Standing by 2
voiceLines.text: Check out my snacks! Want some, Endmin?

voiceLines.title: Assigning to Facility
voiceLines.text: Don't worry if I suddenly zonk out. My suit has a very smart auto-pilot!

voiceLines.title: Greeting 1
voiceLines.text: Hiya, Endmin! How about some exotic dried fin?

voiceLines.title: Greeting 2
voiceLines.text: "See ya!" ... Huh? Oh, Endmin! Hello there!

voiceLines.title: Dijiang Idle Chatter 1
voiceLines.text: Whoa, Dijiang is so different from home! You got a full view of Talos-II and flashy gadgets that I don't recognize! I've only read about stuff like this! It's so cool!

voiceLines.title: Dijiang Idle Chatter 2
voiceLines.text: Hi, Endmin! What? The canteen operators said that I was being too modest? Really?! I didn't want to look too greedy. WAIT! It's an all-you-can take snack bar?! WOOHOO! Snack bar! Here I come!

voiceLines.title: Dijiang Idle Chatter 3
voiceLines.text: Endmin, I'm back from helping out fellow patients! I told the children stories about Endfield and they LOVED IT! What type of stories? Yeah, they're about ... about... "Exotic dried fin! YUM-YUM!" "I LOVE exotic dried fin."

voiceLines.title: Dijiang Idle Chatter 4
voiceLines.text: Endmin! I toasted this marshmallow myself! Why is it a half singed? Oh, heheh, yeah, I think I accidentally dozed off by the fire...

voiceLines.title: Dijiang Idle Chatter 5
voiceLines.text: Nnn — so sleepy... Dealing with those stubborn burdenbeasts was a real workout. Oh? Why'd I go in alone? Well, helping fellow Ætherside Syndrome patients is what I do! Heheh!

voiceLines.title: Dijiang Idle Chatter 6
voiceLines.text: Why do I love snacks so much? 'Cos snack-munching is very relaxing for me ... it feels like floating on the clouds... "Greetings! I am Purrchena!"

voiceLines.title: Offering Gifts
voiceLines.text: Tada! I hand-picked this gift, so it's guaranteed to be delicious! Trust me, Endmin! You won't find a better snack-expert than me! I know all the best secrets of the snack world!

voiceLines.title: Accepting Gifts
voiceLines.text: Ooh, thank you so much, Endmin... *gasp*, almost fell asleep again! Whew ... thank goodness I didn't drop it.

voiceLines.title: Trust Dialog 1
voiceLines.text: When I studied at La Fantoma, my textbooks described plenty of Endfield achievements. That's when I learned about Endfield's commitment to Æther disease prevention... The ambient Æther of Talos-II can inflict rare disorders on people. I really want to do my part and help fellow victims. My friends at the Relief Foundation wrote me very nice recommendations, and that was how I ended up here!

voiceLines.title: Trust Dialog 2
voiceLines.text: Hiya! Some article mentioned the "Brand Ambassador for the Ætherside Environmental Impact Syndrome Relief Foundation"? Oh, yeah, that was me, but the writing's way over the top... I didn't hike across mountains with a victim on my back. Mom and I just gave him a lift to the hospital in our RV. Why aren't my parents Felines? Good question. It's probably because my grandparents weren't Felines.

voiceLines.title: Trust Dialog 3
voiceLines.text: My funsy suit? Dad built the first one when I was a little girl. He fixed up a scrapped exo-skeleton and wrapped it in a plushie to keep me safe in case I dozed off. That old suit was really buggy, but I still have it stashed in my La Fantoma apartment! What about the one I'm wearing? Ahem. This one's top-of-the-line! Techies of the Relief Foundation are always giving me neat upgrades. I've got tons of flashy tech inside this thing!

voiceLines.title: Trust Dialog 4
voiceLines.text: I once dozed off during a major exam and woke up to find the place in total chaos. The proctor and my fellow examinees were shouting for help! They only knew that I had a rare syndrome and thought I was in a coma. Then they panicked when they couldn't pry my suit open. The poor proctor even fell and got injured... How did I do on the exam? Well, I submitted my half-finished paper just to rush the proctor to the school medical room. I could have topped the class.

voiceLines.title: Trust Dialog 5
voiceLines.text: Mom picked me up from the wildlands while delivering supplies in her RV... They'd often spend time with me counting stars and playing games. After the Relief Foundation diagnosed my rare syndrome, Mom and Dad brought me to La Fantoma so I could receive treatment while serving as the Foundation's mascot. I soon learned that I wasn't the only one suffering from Ætherside Syndrome. Heheh. I'm so glad I can help so many like me!

voiceLines.title: Chat 1
voiceLines.text: Nothing beats exotic dried fin, but the finyaki from Neo Tsukushi is amazing too. I visited fellow syndrome patients in the city during a Relief Foundation trip. Everyone told me Neo Tsukushi has the most authentic finyaki. They're right, but now every non-Tsukushi finyaki tastes wrong. I really wanna go there again... Mmm, oh well, I guess I'll stick to my exotic dried fin for now!

voiceLines.title: Chat 2
voiceLines.text: A plush-bot? NUH-UH! Bots like me don't exist on Talos-II! And even if they did, they'd look nothing like me! Endmin, did you fall for those rumors? My electronic sounds! Look, they're NOT synthesized! I just pre-recorded them so people know when I'm dozing off. Here! I'll play a few for you... "Greetings!" "See ya!" "Exotic dried fin! YUM-YUM!" "Is the Endmin hiding snacks behind that mask?" Ack! Stop! That line wasn't meant to be recorded!

voiceLines.title: Chat 3
voiceLines.text: How do I take my meds? Dad furnished this suit with a timed dispenser, and friends from the TGCC polished the tech. How do I eat and clean myself? Hmm... Relief Foundation techies installed a cleaning system that removes any crumbs I accidentally drop! To eat, I just go like this: Ahhhh — NYAM ... KYAAA!! HO-HO-HOOO...! *Glug-glug* Phooo. I'm alive! Saved by cool water... The heat almost killed me... Welp. That's how things work, Endmin.

voiceLines.title: Chat 4
voiceLines.text: My appearance? Purrchena looks like Purrchena, fuzzy-wuvvly... My actual appearance under the suit? Oho, looks like someone is interested in my secrets! Harrrumph! Purrchena is made of cotton candy! Hehe, just joking. I'm actually just ... I'm ... feeling ... a lil'... "Exotic dried fin! HAVE SOME!"

voiceLines.title: Chat 5
voiceLines.text: Of course, of course! My outfit is a huge hit! Everyone — from the Relief Foundation staff, to the friends I helped, to fellow Endfielders who helped me out  — just LOOOOOVES to get a huggy with me. Especially on cold days. All of them tell me the same thing: "You're so soft and warm, Purrchena! It's like cuddling with a little piece of the sun!"

voiceLines.title: Topic: Ætherside Syndrome
voiceLines.text: I used to go to all sorts of places to visit fellow patients in need. Some shared my conditions, but there were a few ... well, the Relief Foundation surgeons told me there was nothing they could do with our current medical technology. I remember visiting an Ætherside Syndrome care center with the team and I just... *Sigh*. It made me realize how fortunate I am to have this suit. It keeps me on my feet instead of a sickbed... I just hope I made a difference for them.

voiceLines.title: Topic: La Fantoma
voiceLines.text: People in La Fantoma are really warm! It's nothing like other places. There are no deserts, no Landbreaker roadblocks... Just massive parks, the ocean, and lively music fests! Of course, La Fantoma snacks are my favorite. I could also hardly tell the Oripathy-positives apart from the rest... *Sigh*. If only we could bring Ætherside Syndrome under control like we did with Oripathy.

voiceLines.title: Topic: RV
voiceLines.text: When I was a little girl, the RV felt super humongous to me. Mom drove it across the world with Dad and I. I've seen snowy mountains, deserts, forests, and giant lakes. I was young, but I was strong and helped people move tons of cargo on and off our RV. They really liked me and gave me lots of sweets. I thought all the snacks on Talos-II would never fill my Mom's RV... But her RV seems smaller now.

voiceLines.title: Topic: The Bonekrusher Clan
voiceLines.text: Endmin, I just don't understand! Why would the Landbreakers expose themselves to the Æther...? It's crazy ... and their derangement is a classic symptom of Ætherside Syndrome... Why would they do that to themselves? Why do they get sick on purpose? With the very thing we're fighting so hard to stop? What? Was I being too serious? No, it's that... Ugh. It's making me so angry! Super angry!

voiceLines.title: Topic: Exotic Dried Fin!
voiceLines.text: Exotic dried fin, yummy, yummy... Sweet ... spicy ... sour... E-Endmin? I ... I'm totally asleep right now, just so you know. Zzz... "Exotic dried fin! YUM-YUM!"

voiceLines.title: Resource/Collectible Detected 1
voiceLines.text: Oh! There's something shiny over there! Please tell me it's a treat!

voiceLines.title: Resource/Collectible Detected 2
voiceLines.text: Ooh, look here! Heheh, what do you think we'll find inside?

voiceLines.title: Unexplored Area Detected
voiceLines.text: Hmm? Is something sparkling over there?

voiceLines.title: Powerful Enemy Discovered
voiceLines.text: Eek, that one looks super mean... But I'll keep everyone safe!

voiceLines.title: Mining 1
voiceLines.text: My plushie suit is tougher than it looks!

voiceLines.title: Mining 2
voiceLines.text: Let me help! My suit's got infinite pow ... power... "See ya!"

voiceLines.title: Opening a Crate
voiceLines.text: Ooh, what a find...! There might be snacks in this.

voiceLines.title: Acquiring Aurylene
voiceLines.text: I've read about Aurylenes from "Environmental Science of Talos-II"... Aww, look at it — so sparkly and pretty! Just like in the pictures, heheh.

voiceLines.title: Eliminating the Blight
voiceLines.text: There... Both people and burdenbeasts are now safe.

voiceLines.title: Rest
voiceLines.text: I've still got energy! In fact, I'm super pumped...

voiceLines.title: Tactical Use 1
voiceLines.text: Take this! Don't drift off!

voiceLines.title: Tactical Use 2
voiceLines.text: Back to life!

voiceLines.title: Danger Warning
voiceLines.text: Danger! Get behind me now!

voiceLines.title: Injured
voiceLines.text: Hoo... It's starting to feel like a dream...

voiceLines.title: 0 HP
voiceLines.text: Sorry ... so sleepy...

voiceLines.title: Team Encouragement 1
voiceLines.text: Amazing! Glad I was awake for that!

voiceLines.title: Team Encouragement 2
voiceLines.text: We're the dream team!

voiceLines.title: Encouragement Response 1
voiceLines.text: Heheh, you're making me blush.

voiceLines.title: Encouragement Response 2
voiceLines.text: Exotic dried fin's on me!

voiceLines.title: Combat Begins 1
voiceLines.text: Get behind me, guys!

voiceLines.title: Combat Begins 2
voiceLines.text: No one's getting a scratch on my watch!

voiceLines.title: Combat Victory 1
voiceLines.text: Is everyone safe and sound?

voiceLines.title: Combat Victory 2
voiceLines.text: Don't mess with this brand ambassador... "YUM-YUM!"

voiceLines.title: Combat Victory 3
voiceLines.text: *Hoo* ... nice work, everyone! Now snack time!

voiceLines.title: Combat Victory 4
voiceLines.text: That was tough... Everyone okay? Good, I'll just... "Exotic dried fin! HAVE SOME!"

voiceLines.title: Combat Defeat
voiceLines.text: It's on me... I didn't try hard enough to protect everyone. Next time, I... No, I won't let this happen ever again.

voiceLines.title: Final Strike 1
voiceLines.text: Back off now!

voiceLines.title: Final Strike 2
voiceLines.text: You won't pass!

voiceLines.title: Battle Skill 1
voiceLines.text: I'm totally awake!

voiceLines.title: Battle Skill 2
voiceLines.text: YA-HAY! "Incoming"

voiceLines.title: Battle Skill 3
voiceLines.text: Don't you dare!

voiceLines.title: Combo Skill Ready 1
voiceLines.text: Purrchena, ready for action!

voiceLines.title: Combo Skill Ready 2
voiceLines.text: GO, exotic dried fin!

voiceLines.title: Combo Casting 1
voiceLines.text: Here I come!

voiceLines.title: Combo Casting 2
voiceLines.text: No one bullies my friends!

voiceLines.title: Finisher 1
voiceLines.text: Hasta la vista!

voiceLines.title: Finisher 2
voiceLines.text: No dozing off!

voiceLines.title: Ultimate 1
voiceLines.text: Haha! Your sorry came LATE!

voiceLines.title: Ultimate 2
voiceLines.text: Hmph! Bully! "See ya!"

voiceLines.title: Ultimate 3
voiceLines.text: You deserve a snack for that!

potential1.author: 黑犬
potential1.description: Exotic dried fin! YUM! Finyaki! YUMMY-YUM TOO! Which one should I eat first? RAWR! I don't choose! I'll eat them both in one bite!

potential3.author: 怂松鼠
potential3.description: "KYAA! It's the Purry Big Feline!" The children of the medical center would happily crowd around her every time she visits.

potential5.author: とびはち
potential5.description: Purrchena had a dream of flying cakes, a world where she can gently launch herself towards the fluffy clouds.
